odoo.name: MCP Server Connector
odoo.summary: Model Context Protocol server inside Odoo: AI agents and MCP clients search, report on and (if you allow it) edit Odoo records with Odoo API keys, per-model permissions and an audit log.

odoo.name: MCP OAuth 2.1 Sign-In
odoo.summary: OAuth 2.1 authorization server for the MCP Connector: MCP clients sign in with the user's Odoo login and consent instead of a pasted API key (PKCE, resource indicators, scopes).

odoo.name: AI Bill Digitizer
odoo.summary: Fill draft vendor bills from PDF bills with any OpenAI-compatible LLM, local or cloud. Works with Odoo's own upload and journal alias import, checks totals and duplicates, logs every run.

mcp.name: MCP Server Connector for Odoo 19
mcp.summary: Streamable-HTTP MCP server (2026-07-28 and legacy protocols) that runs inside your own Odoo; connect Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Cursor to your ERP with per-model permissions.
